name: std::popcount

declarations.code:
template <class T>

constexpr int popcount(T x) noexcept;

intro:
Returns the number of 1 bits in the value of x.

This overload participates in overload resolution only if T is an unsigned integer type (that is, unsigned char, unsigned short, unsigned int, unsigned long, unsigned long long, or an extended unsigned integer type).

sections.title: Parameters
sections.text:
x

 -

 value of unsigned integer type

sections.title: Return value
sections.text: The number of 1 bits in the value of x.

sections.title: Notes
sections.text:
The name popcount is a contraction for "population count".

guides.name: std::popcount
guides.summary: Count the switched-on bits in a number.
guides.analogy: Imagine a row of tiny switches. This tells you how many are turned on.
guides.signature:
template<class T>
constexpr int popcount(T value) noexcept;
guides.note: The input must be an unsigned integer type. It counts binary ones, not decimal digits.
